tomorrow_am|half|false.headline: Dawn blue catfish at Smallwood State Park. Good window, high confidence.
tomorrow_am|half|false.rig_line: 7/0-8/0 circle, 18-24 in 50 lb mono leader, #3/0 barrel swivel, 8 mm bead, 3-6 oz no-roll or pyramid on fish-finder slide, fresh menhaden or gizzard shad chunk

drivers.text: season 'good' for the region this month
drivers.label: reasoning

details.confidence_note: flow/tide data in hand; DNR report under 30 days mentions it; water temp measured

presence.note: Park page lists 'catfish' (species not stated). Fish and Hunt Maryland lists blue catfish for Mattawoman Creek.

access.note: Smallwood State Park, 2750 Sweden Point Road, Marbury MD 20658. Day use $3/vehicle weekdays, $3/person weekends and holidays (+$2 non-residents).

rules.text: Maryland tidal waters: harvest 01-01–12-31 none none (warning: Applies to MD waters. On the tidal Potomac mainstem PRFC rules were not checked.)
Tidal Mattawoman Creek, Maryland. Not on the PRFC mainstem, so no PRFC question at the park (reasoning).
License: Maryland Chesapeake Bay & Coastal Sport License (park page says required 16+). Matt states he holds MD tidal; not verified here. (per Matt; not verified)

rig.primary: 7/0-8/0 circle, 18-24 in 50 lb mono leader, #3/0 barrel swivel, 8 mm bead, 3-6 oz no-roll or pyramid on fish-finder slide, fresh menhaden or gizzard shad chunk
rig.alternate: 5/0 circle, 18 in 30 lb mono, barrel swivel, bead, 1-2 oz egg or bank sinker slide, chicken liver or cut shad
rig.switch_trigger: Only small fish or crabs stripping cut bait in 30 min, or fishing a slower tributary bank
rig.gear_note: Best on a heavy 8-10 ft catfish/surf rod with 50-65 lb braid. Matt's Rhino catfish setup with 65 lb braid (unconfirmed) or his 10 ft Penn Pursuit IV fit; the Crossfire MH is undergunned for big blues. His 4/0-5/0 circles are small for big blues - buy 7/0-8/0
